correctness.rationale: All crown distances 0/1/2/3 and edge-distance roles are proved explicitly. Different ordered edge pairs have nonzero zero-sum role-vector difference supported on at least two indices; this proves all-order edge resolution iff no two indices are omitted. Parity proves crown vertex resolution, and the inspected rook Lemma 6.2 proves prism transfer from n>=4 with n=3 counterexample. Counting and TAR graph constructions are complete, with n=3..6 all-subsets definition-level tests.

value.rationale: A literal identity of *all* feasible landmark subsets across vertex and edge identification in crowns, and ordinary vertex identification in a nonisomorphic prism family, is stronger than equal optimal metric dimensions/bases. It transports every cardinality of working sensors and every feasible-state TAR reconfiguration graph, not only an easy numerical minimum, with a sharp threshold at n=4 and physically different distance/edge structures.
